{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders
completed_only = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
valid_orders = completed_only[completed_only['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check the filtered population
print("Total valid orders (completed, non-QA):", len(valid_orders))

# Check unique channels
print("Unique channels after filtering:", valid_orders['channel'].unique())

# Compute total revenue per channel
channel_revenue = valid_orders.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue'].sum().round(2)
print("Total revenue per channel:", channel_revenue.to_dict())

# Identify the channel with highest revenue
max_channel = channel_revenue.idxmax()
max_revenue = channel_revenue.max()

print(f"Channel with most revenue: {max_channel} with ${max_revenue:,.2f}")"}
